title: German submarine carrying uranium to Japan

tellings.quote: that famous submarine that they stopped that had the measurement you know in pieces in it and all the uranium you know and the engineers that was going to Japan that supposedly Oenheimer visited at a crucial time because he couldn't figure out how to make the freaking bomb work.

related.note: Same subject as the German submarine uranium story: Nazi uranium on a submarine ending up in American bombs. The core claim differs: a deliberate SS deal to send it to the US, rather than a captured submarine bound for Japan.

plain: In 1945 a German submarine headed for Japan was stopped, and it carried uranium, engineers and parts in pieces, according to the writer Peter Levenda, who calls it "that famous submarine" without naming a source. He says J. Robert Oppenheimer, the scientist who led the American atomic bomb project, supposedly visited it at a crucial moment "because he couldn't figure out how to make the freaking bomb work." If true, it would mean Nazi materials and know-how helped finish the American bomb.
